title: ZoNexus
content: ZoNexus LLC started developing electron microscopy accessories and tools such as TEM sample holders in 2019. The first products developed by ZoNexus were an in situ, air-free transfer, double-tilt biasing TEM holder and an air-free transfer module for scanning electron and focused ion beam microscopes used for characterizing air-sensitive materials such as those used in solid-state batteries. Since then, ZoNexus has developed several unique sample holders such as an in situ continuous rotation tomography TEM holder, a piezo-driven straining holder, TEM holders for cathodoluminescence, high-throughput TEM holders, Peltier stage for SEMs, and several versions of cryogenic TEM holders. ZoNexus’s R&D and manufacturing facilities are located in Richmond, California, United States.
